emily_cs: Quick handoff for Silverline private VPC. Network peering and subnets good. Two blockers: KMS decrypt failing for inference service, and security wants a written attestation that CloudTrail logs stored in their bucket will be retained immutable for 730 days.
raj_se: What's the KMS error in their agent logs?
emily_cs: They reported: `AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:444555666777:key/9f8e7d6c`. Happens when pods call /v1/secrets/decrypt.
dan_kms: Likely key policy doesn't include Redwood's service principal, or no grant exists. Ask whether the CMK is in their account and if they prefer updating the key policy vs creating a grant.
tina_net: Also confirm the node IAM role has kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. We often see IRSA issues with EKS service accounts missing the mapped role.
emily_cs: They said key is in their account and gave role ARN `arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/sl-infer`. I suggested attaching this minimal policy to the role:
```
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:444555666777:key/9f8e7d6c"}]}
```
dan_kms: For key policy snippet (they own CMK) I recommended: `{"Sid":"AllowRedwoodSvc","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-svc"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"]}`. Or they can CreateGrant(GranteePrincipal=our-role,Operations=[Decrypt,GenerateDataKey]).
raj_se: For audit logs — are they forwarding CloudTrail to S3 then Firehose to Splunk?
emily_cs: Yes. Security wants proof that logs will be immutable for 730 days. They're asking for a one-paragraph attestation from Redwood and a sample bucket policy + Firehose role policy.
tina_net: Short note: enabling S3 Versioning + Object Lock (GOVERNANCE or COMPLIANCE) achieves immutability. If they enable Object Lock COMPLIANCE, even account admins cannot override retention. Lifecycle transitions fine but retention cannot be shortened.
dan_kms: We can provide an attestation template but only once their bucket has Object Lock enabled and versioning on — otherwise we should state conditions.
emily_cs: Timeline: security wants confirmation within 48 hours; procurement warned they may pause renewal if compliance sign-off missing. Marked as at-risk on my tracker.
raj_se: I'll draft a one-paragraph attestation that says: we will not delete or modify CloudTrail objects once they are written to the customer bucket provided Object Lock+Versioning are enabled and Firehose uses their S3 role. We'll add standard caveats.
dan_kms: I'll produce a one-page KMS checklist: confirm key ARN/account, whether policy or grant, sample policy + grant call, test command: `aws kms encrypt --key-id <key> --plaintext hello --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > /tmp/ct && aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb:///tmp/ct`. Ask them to paste the full AWS error if it fails.
emily_cs: Action items: dan -> KMS checklist; raj -> attestation + Firehose/S3 sample policy; tina -> confirm Firehose role network permissions. I'll set up a 20m call with Silverline security tomorrow 09:30 ET.
trustee-bot: Reminder: onboard-task Silverline-#812 due in 2 days.
emily_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll post the meeting notes and attach both snippets. Drop any short clarifications here and I'll include them in the runbook. :white_check_mark:
